sourceText:
Better Than Potato Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:43pm

Ingredients




1 cup Uncle Bens rice
2 cups sliced celery
4 hard-cooked eggs, chipped
4 tablespoons prepared mustard
1 cucumber, pared
diced
2 cups mayonnaise or salad dressing
1 med. onion, finely chopped
1/2 teaspoon salt
8 radishes, sliced

Preparation

1 Cook rice according to package directions. Transfer to large bowl, cover and chill. Add mayonnaise or salad dressing, celery, onion, mustard and salt to chilled rice; mix well. Cover and chill. Stir in remaining ingredients before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
